ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution dominated by low-intensity (black/grey) values covering approximately 80% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/off-white) clusters covering approximately 20% primarily at the distal extremities and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones are mapped to the extreme left and right distal tips. Discontinuous white mottling and focal spotting are observed along the interior margins of the trailing edge, transitioning to a solid low-intensity black field in the central and lower fluke regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the central peduncle insertion point by high-intensity water spray and turbulence.
